name: AI coding benchmarks
question: Can AI models do real engineering tasks?
metric: Best score so far on SWE-bench Verified, the share of real GitHub issues resolved
solvedIf: Models resolve nearly every real engineering task
trendLabel: Best SWE-bench Verified score so far, in percent, by model release month.
caution: A benchmark is not a job. These tasks are fixed in advance and scored automatically, so a high score does not show that a model can run a real software project.
Scores differ widely between benchmarks, and models can be tuned for well-known tests. New models are not always tested right away, so the latest result can lag.
rule: Improving when the best score is higher than a year before.

analysis.title: Other public benchmarks
analysis.intro: The best score depends heavily on the benchmark, so no single number settles this.
points: METR estimates the longest task a model completes half the time at about 17 hours of human work, with a range of 8 to 55 hours.

scoreReason: The best model resolves 83% of SWE-bench Verified tasks.
